From Birendranagar, for Nepali kitchens

Masalas for the food we share.

Avaru is developing spice blends for Nepali home cooks. Our first product in testing is a dry masala made to help you prepare tomato-and-timur momo dipping achar.

Join product testing ↗Meet the first product

Recipe, pack size, price and launch timing are not final.

One useful distinction

Momo achar is the sauce.
Momo achar masala helps you make it.

Avaru Momo Achar Masala is a dry spice blend. It is not a ready-to-eat achar, and it is not used in momo filling.

What the product does

From dry blend to the bowl

  1. 01Dry masala

    The product being tested: a measured spice blend.

  2. 02Prepare your achar

    Combine it as part of a tomato-and-timur momo achar recipe. The final method is still being tested.

  3. 03Serve and share

    A finished dipping achar you feel happy to put beside your momo.

First blend in testing

Avaru Momo Achar Masala

Made for home cooks who want a clearer starting point when preparing momo dipping achar. Testing will shape the final recipe and instructions.
